title: NoSelfHarm
description: A mod that fixes MC-110386, preventing mobs from attacking themselves
body:
This mod implements a fix for [MC-110386](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-110386), an issue in which certain mobs like zombies would attack themselves when targeted by a mob of the same type as themselves. 

The fix implements a single change: mobs will not target themselves when calling mobs of the same type for help.
